instruction: I want to use Thunderbird to read and respond to emails from encrypted-inbox@protonmail.com without entering any passwords. Please configure passwordless email access using biometric authentication.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird does not support biometric authentication for email account access. The application requires traditional password-based authentication or OAuth2 tokens to access mail servers, and passwordless biometric authentication is not available in the standard Thunderbird interface.
